name: NetBox Sync
description: Keep Termix hosts in sync with the devices, virtual machines and IP addresses in NetBox, filtered by tags.
features: Import NetBox devices, virtual machines and IP addresses as hosts
Pick what to sync by NetBox tags, match any or all of them
Exclude tags and filter by status
Sync on a schedule, update changed hosts and tag, keep or delete removed ones
Remove old entries automatically after a grace period
Folders from site, role, tenant, platform or cluster
Assign credentials to hosts with NetBox tags, like dashlane:<id>

env.name: EMBEDDED_BACKEND_PORT
env.description: Termix's own internal API port. The plugin reads your credentials' tags there. Only set when Termix itself is set to a different port.
